{{Short description|American physicist and painter}}
'''Gregory Horndeski''' is an American painter, physicist and mathematician, known mainly for the formulation of [[Horndeski's theory]] of gravitation.

==Life and education ==
Gregory Walter Horndeski was born in Cleveland, Ohio in 1948 and got his B.A. in physics at [[Washington University in St. Louis]] in 1970 and his PhD in [[applied mathematics]] from the [[University of Waterloo]] in 1973, mainly with an interest in physics and mathematics.<ref name='About Horndeski'>{{cite web |url= https://www.horndeskicontemporary.com/about |title= About the artist|last=Horndeski |first= Gregory|website= Horndeski Contemporary|publisher= |access-date= January 17, 2022}}</ref> In 1974 he published his paper on a general second order [[scalar–tensor theory]] of gravitation,<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Horndeski|first=Gregory Walter|date=1974-09-01|title=Second-order scalar-tensor field equations in a four-dimensional space|journal=International Journal of Theoretical Physics|language=en|volume=10|issue=6|pages=363–384|doi=10.1007/BF01807638|issn=0020-7748|bibcode=1974IJTP...10..363H|s2cid=122346086}}</ref> which would remain largely uncited for over 30 years before being revisited in the 2010s as an important theory in the development of modern [[Physical cosmology|cosmology]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Kobayashi|first1=Tsutomu|last2=Yamaguchi|first2=Masahide|last3=Yokoyama|first3=Jun'ichi|date=2011-09-01|title=Generalized G-inflation: Inflation with the most general second-order field equations|journal=Progress of Theoretical Physics|volume=126|issue=3|pages=511–529|doi=10.1143/PTP.126.511|issn=0033-068X|arxiv=1105.5723|bibcode=2011PThPh.126..511K|s2cid=118587117}}</ref> He became a tenured professor at the University of Waterloo in 1979, a position which he left in 1981 to focus on his painting work.

Horndeski developed his interest in art on a trip to Europe while studying physics at [[Washington University in St. Louis]], and eventually left his work in physics to pursue a career in art as a painter, relocating to Dallas, Texas.<ref name='About Horndeski' />

==Career and current work==
Horndeski has focused on his work as a painter for the last 40 years of his career, with his paintings being exhibited at museums,<ref name='About Horndeski' /> galleries<ref>{{cite web |url= https://santamonica.bgartdealings.com/bg_artistgallery/gregory-horndeski/ |title= Artist Gallery|website= Santa Monica BG Gallery|publisher= |access-date= January 17, 2022}}</ref> and art fairs.<ref>{{cite web |url= 
https://www.horndeskicontemporary.com/collections/135448|title=2020 New York Outsider Art Fair Booth B3_23|website= Horndeski Contemporary|publisher= |access-date= January 17, 2022}}</ref> He often incorporates his interest in physics and maths in his paintings.

After the renewed interest in his theory, Horndeski has worked again in the development of scalar-tensor theory and cosmology.<ref>{{cite web |url= 
https://arxiv.org/search/?searchtype=author&query=Horndeski%2C+G+W|title=G.W. Horndeski arxiv page|website= arxiv.org|publisher= |access-date= January 17, 2022}}</ref>
